_doc: Gifts tab (families view, growth plan W49-A2). The ONE place the gift picks are defined: ordered sections of barcodes, an optional heading per section (never above the first section; a heading never names a price, a discount, a date or a giveaway). Every price text on the tab comes from the served table (/api/stock ladders) through the cards themselves. Rule: only existing, referee-passed, sellable pieces: data/cards.json cards with a QC-passed photo (photo + photo_qc true; no colour tiles, no rings, no hair), and Gradient Edit pieces with a referee-passed photo (1268 Ice Blue: the only Gradient render that passed 2 referees, morning_review/19_live_gradient_audit; ai_image true = the card says 'AI-styled image'). A pick that is not sellable right now is simply not shown; with fewer than 4 sellable picks the Gifts chip is hidden. tests/storefront-gifts.test.mjs checks all of this.
